subject: Recap + token economics & model mix — BrightCart pilot
summary: Post-demo follow-up capturing expected monthly token volumes, target $/1M tokens, and per-model volume split (chat/embeddings/rerank). Confirms next steps: procurement intro, pilot MA plan attachment, and technical kickoff once procurement greenlights budget.
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@brightcart.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + token economics & model mix — BrightCart pilot

Hi Sanjay — great conversation today, thanks for the clear context. Quick written recap to make sure we’re aligned and to give you concrete numbers for procurement.

Call highlights (short):
- Goal: integrate recommendation chat + semantic search + a reranking pass for top results in BrightCart checkout flow. Pilot scope: 2 region-limited skus, ~3 week technical POC, then 3-month pilot.
- Usage profile: heavy read/search in discovery (embeddings), medium chat/messages during checkout, occasional batch rerank during A/B tests.

Your rough traffic estimate you gave on call: ~50M tokens/mo initially, scaling to ~300M tokens/mo over 6–9 months (seasonal peaks higher). You also mentioned procurement target of ~$1,000 per 1M tokens as a ballpark.

Our suggested model mix for pilot (initial recommendation):
- chat (instruction/few-shot responses): 65% of token volume (~32.5M tokens/mo at 50M baseline)
- embeddings (semantic search + similarity): 30% of requests but ~25% of token-equivalent usage (~12.5M tokens/mo)
- rerank (dense-pass / reranking run on top-N): 5% (~2.5M tokens/mo)

Cost sanity check at your target $1,000 / 1M tokens:
- Baseline (50M tokens/mo) => 50 * $1,000 = $50,000/mo
- Model-split breakdown (approx):
  - chat: 32.5M tokens -> $32,500/mo
  - embeddings: 12.5M tokens -> $12,500/mo
  - rerank: 2.5M tokens -> $2,500/mo

Note: these are illustrative pricing bands for budgeting. Actual unit economics we offer vary by model family and reserved capacity. For Reserved/Dedicated plans we can give stepped discounts at commit levels (e.g., 100M+ and 250M+ bands). I attached a short MA plan and a token econ workbook that shows alternative bands and an example ramp to 300M tokens.

Open questions / asks for procurement:
1) Can procurement confirm the target $/1M tokens band they’d expect at pilot vs steady-state? If $1,000 is pilot-only and steady-state target is lower (e.g., $700–$900), we can model discounts.
2) Can procurement share preferred contract term (1q pilot cover vs 3-month pilot + review)?
3) Any compliance or SOC2 evidence procurement needs before contract routing? We can provide standard artifacts.

Next steps I propose:
- Camila: send MA plan + token-econ workbook (attached) — today.
- Sanjay: intro to procurement contact and confirm budget band — by Tue 5/18.
- Redwood: produce a 1-week perf estimate for dedicated pool + example SLA for the pilot (we’ll include model/latency profile) — by Wed 5/20.

Attachments: BrightCart_Pilot_MAPlan_v1.pdf, token_econ_model_breakdown.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll wait for procurement intro and will schedule the technical kickoff once we have a greenlight on budget.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0148

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + token economics & model mix — BrightCart pilot

Adding a couple quick notes from a pricing/ops POV — copying Vivek for quota/discount guidance.

Camila / Vivek — if BrightCart’s target is $1,000 / 1M tokens for pilot, we should push to secure at least a 3-month commit for a reduced unit-rate on steady state. For the pilot:
- Recommend we offer a 10% pilot discount at 50M band to reduce procurement friction (pilot price effective $900 / 1M).
- For ramp to 300M, propose a tiered commit: 0–99M @ $900, 100–249M @ $800, 250M+ @ $650 (these are internal suggested bands).

Model-split note: embeddings are typically charged differently (per embedding or per vector compute) — Camila, please flag in the workbook that embedding costs can be quoted as flat per-100k vectors in addition to token-equivalent for clarity.

Vivek — can you confirm if we can include a one-time onboarding credit (e.g., $5k) for pilot success metrics? That usually helps procurement sign-off.

Rishi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@brightcart.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Sat, 15 May 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + token economics & model mix — BrightCart pilot

Thanks Camila — the recap looks right and the workbook is helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) The 50M baseline is conservative for pilot; expected pilot throughput might be 60–80M tokens/mo depending on checkout traffic. Can you re-run the baseline table at 75M tokens so procurement has accurate top-line numbers?
2) For embeddings: procurement wants clear metric — are we billing by tokens or by number of vectors? If vectors, can you provide an example cost line (e.g., $X per 100k vectors) so they can map to their telemetry?
3) Procurement is ok with a 3-month pilot for a modest discount but they will push for a 90-day SLA and a clause for credits if availability drops below 99.5%.

Looping in procurement — please respond with any contract must-haves (cc’d).

Sanjay
Head of Product, BrightCart
sanjay.patel@brightcart.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@brightcart.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + token economics & model mix — BrightCart pilot

Great questions — quick answers and next steps.

1) Re-run at 75M baseline — attached in token_econ_model_breakdown.xlsx (tab: "75M_baseline"). Quick snapshot at $900 pilot band (10% off your $1,000 request):
   - Total tokens: 75M -> $67,500/mo @ $900 per 1M
   - Chat (65%): 48.75M -> $43,875/mo
   - Embeddings (25%): 18.75M -> $16,875/mo (we modeled embeddings as token-equivalent here for budgeting)
   - Rerank (10%): 7.5M -> $6,750/mo

2) Embeddings billing — we can present two formats in the SOW: token-equivalent (simpler for early budgeting) or vector-billing. Example vector billing line we can offer: $250 per 100k embedding vectors (example mapping provided in workbook). On your telemetry (average 2 vectors/query, 1.2M queries/mo), that maps to ~24M vectors -> $60,000/mo if billed purely by vector — which is why the token-equivalent approach is often easier initially. We’ll include both lines for procurement to evaluate.

3) SLA / credits — we can accept a 99.5% pilot SLA with a standard credits schedule; production SLA for Dedicated can be higher. I’ll include a draft SLA clause in the legal SOW.

Next steps (updated):
- Camila: send updated workbook (done) + SOW draft with both token & vector billing options + draft SLA clause — today.
- Procurement: confirm preferred billing format (token-equivalent vs vector) and any mandatory contract language — by Tue 5/19.
- Redwood (Vivek/Rishi): confirm onboarding credit (Vivek) and finalize pilot discount band — by Wed 5/20.

Attachments: BrightCart_Pilot_MAPlan_v1.pdf, token_econ_model_breakdown.xlsx

Looking forward — I’ll schedule a short follow-up (30m) next week once procurement confirms format.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0148
